metadata.name: NeuroMechFly / FlyGym simplified micro-CT anatomy
metadata.specimen: Adult female Drosophila melanogaster micro-CT morphology; a scientific reference model, not reconstructed from the user photograph.
metadata.rotationRule: body local transform = T(pos) * R(quat) * ordered product R(joint.axis, joint.rest + animationOffset); child bodies attached after the full joint rotation. The restQuat field is already quat multiplied by all rest rotations.
metadata.geometryRule: positions already converted from source meters to mm; do not scale by 1000 again. For mirrorY meshes use mesh.scale.y=-1 only; do not mirror the body hierarchy, joint axes, or positions again. THREE.BufferGeometry.setIndex(indices); computeVertexNormals().
metadata.jointNote: Leg DOFs follow official biological preset; non-leg segment origins and freely selectable rotational DOFs follow FlyGym ALL_BIOLOGICAL. Animation offsets are illustrative, not measured dance kinematics.
